intro: Liberia has a rainy Atlantic coast and some of West Africa's largest remaining rainforest.

chapters.title: Forests and coast
text: The coast has beaches and mangroves. Inland, hills rise to Mount Wuteve. Sapo National Park protects rainforest with pygmy hippos and forest elephants.

chapters.title: Rain
text: Monrovia is one of the wettest capitals in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A small, shy hippo of West African forests.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Liberia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
